english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for luck, chance, or how successful an attempt turns out to be.

exampleSentences.english: It was pure luck that I got it right this time, even though it was so difficult.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今次真係運氣好，咁難都畀我撞中。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 wan6 hei3 hou2 gam2 naan4 dou1 bei2 ngo5 zong6 zung3

english.note: Use this for chance as luck or an outcome that depends on luck.

exampleSentences.english: Whether we win this time depends on chance.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 jeng4 m4 jeng4 jiu3 kaau3 wan6 hei3
